name: My Town of Sidon
source:
I’ve devoted years to this investigation. These disappearances go back half a century – at minimum. The police have found no leads, no evidence, nothing. Over thirty people went to this town and never returned.

[From [url=https://redrubee0713.itch.io/my-town-of-sidon]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
我花了多年时间进行这项调查。这些失踪至少可以追溯到半个世纪前。警方没有发现任何线索，没有证据，什么也没有。三十多人去了这个小镇，再也没有回来。

[来自[url=https://redrubee0713.itch.io/my-town-of-sidon]Itch.io[/url]]
